body:
# Final general review of GraphGoblin #486 / PR #553

**CHANGES_REQUIRED.** The PR adds a required workspace test that fails when the temporary directory is reached through a filesystem alias. The adapter correctly returns the physical path. The new assertion expects the spelling used to create the fixture. The requested correction is test-only. A second, lower-priority test observation concerns coverage on Windows systems with two drive letters.

## Findings

### P2 · Compare the owned temporary workspace with its physical path

The new `engine workspace filesystem boundary` test creates `dataDir` under `os.tmpdir()` and derives its expected temporary path with `join(dataDir, "workspaces", run.id)`. `OwnedRunResources` explicitly supports an aliased data root. It resolves the physical data directory once with `realpath`, creates its managed `workspaces` directory there, and uses that physical path for the script working directory, the ownership claim and subsequent resolution. The fixture uses exact string equality on all three values. Its first failing assertion is the script cwd at line 141. The canonical comparison later in the test is only for `journal.use`. [Fixture creation](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/infrastructure/src/fs/fs.test.ts#L33) · [Introduced expectation and assertions](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/infrastructure/src/fs/fs.test.ts#L129) · [Temp resolution and claim](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/infrastructure/src/fs/owned-resources.ts#L98) · [Physical root](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/infrastructure/src/fs/owned-resources.ts#L199)

A supported Linux configuration demonstrates the mismatch by inspection. With `TMPDIR=/tmp/gg-alias` pointing to `/tmp/gg-physical`, the fixture expects `/tmp/gg-alias/gg-wp-e3-…/workspaces/<run>` and the adapter supplies `/tmp/gg-physical/gg-wp-e3-…/workspaces/<run>`. Both refer to the same directory and its completed file. A repository test already exercises the ownership adapter with a configured data-directory junction. The new assertion can therefore fail the normal infrastructure unit/coverage gate on a working installation. This specific configuration was traced in source. The retained hosted run passed in its own environment. [Existing alias ownership control](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/infrastructure/src/sqlite/history-cleanup.test.ts#L229) · [Package gate](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/infrastructure/package.json)

**Correction and verification.** In the temp branch of the expected-path expression, use `join(realpathSync(dataDir), "workspaces", run.id)`. Keep the exact script cwd, on-disk result, journal claim and reuse assertions. Keep the user-supplied spelling for fixed paths. Verify the same temp case with an ordinary temporary directory and with a temporary root reached through a symlink or junction.

### P3 · Guarantee that the Windows relative-path fixtures supply a relative input

Two new relative-path cases use `path.relative(process.cwd(), target)` with `target` under `os.tmpdir()`. Windows returns an absolute path when the two paths have different drive letters. On such a host, the adapter and the engine tests can pass under their “relative” labels while exercising absolute fixed paths. This is a coverage gap. Genuine relative-path execution exists in the recorded QA. A same-volume fixture and an explicit `isAbsolute(input) === false` assertion would make these cases truthful on every supported configuration. [Adapter fixture](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/infrastructure/src/fs/fs.test.ts#L46) · [Engine fixture](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/infrastructure/src/fs/fs.test.ts#L111)

## Source and review scope

Independent general slot 3 of 3, GPT-6.2 Astra, MAX effort. Frozen checkout `G:/ggq/gg-i4-486-delivery/GraphGoblin` was clean. Candidate `b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1`, tree `86f422bb091515defe3d612df660988e5b47ffeb`, direct parent `29e165e14fdda138300ba2a34585ddd47268b475`, target `a60843a9050b3a203726db84f6abf1f45b8bc694`. The retained main and PR readbacks bind those revisions as of 2026-11-21 21:44:37 UTC. Tested merge `dde965f4e2263b954bc6462f3985b985ae324aa5` has target and candidate as its parents and the exact candidate tree. [Source binding](./SOURCE-BINDING.json) · [Admission](../i4-553-final-astra-scan3-admission-01/admission.json)

I read the complete target-to-head functional diff for 54 paths, comprising 21 production or test-support files, 27 test files and six documents. This includes new and removed assertions. I traced the changed handlers and selected unchanged callers and consumers through their normal entry points. The complete path list is bound by the source map. Git modes and blob IDs matched the direct parent for all 54. Fifty also matched corrected source `4d982162ca60e885d5af22f66076383a048215db`. The combined documents are `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/04-node-catalog.md`, `docs/06-harness-integration.md` and `docs/guide/03-run-and-observe.md`. I checked the repository instructions, issue workflow, approved register, #486 requirements, ADR-0088, and the selected architecture revision against the delta. [Source map](../i4-486-final-scan3-preparation-02/source54-carry.json) · [Approved register](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/docs/delivery/2026-11-17-five-intents-register.md) · [Boundary inventory](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-486-authored-failures/architecture/revision-03/boundaries.md)

| Area | What the source and evidence support |
| --- | --- |
| Attribution and public copy | The observation belongs to the current evaluator invocation. Top-level authored compilation and unsafe regex, dynamic `$eval`, limit identity, Liquid locations and fallback from preparation/coercion/conversion have distinct routes. Site labels and public reasons are bounded. Mutate and Exit keep their previous contracts. [Domain evaluator](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/domain/src/expression.ts#L156) · [Failure construction](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/engine/src/authored-failure.ts#L129) |
| Leaf and child effects | Traced Script, Heartbeat, Decision, Wait and Subloop. A failing input mapping precedes child admission. A failing output mapping preserves the completed child and deduplication. Existing earlier probes and file effects remain factual. Shape and region checks occur after evaluation, and a genuine failed child retains linked ownership. [Child handler](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/engine/src/handlers/subloop.ts#L203) |
| Inference and diagnostics | Traced initial preparation, saved prompts, continuation, fresh sessions, missing sessions and prior submission evidence. The unusable uncertain task stops before model resolution. A winning authored repair-prompt or transform failure after a result can describe the last actual turn. Stronger interruptions retain precedence. The canonical rerender carries its private diagnostic into the existing log path without placing it in public options. Prior submission evidence survives the current reconstruction. [Inference execution](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/engine/src/handlers/inference.ts#L300) · [Private error](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/engine/src/failure-publication.ts#L6) · [Run manager](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/engine/src/run-manager.ts#L2667) |
| Workspace, delivery and docs | The engine renders and trims before calling the fixed/temp filesystem port, caches successful resolution and retains the terminal return receipt. External port exceptions keep the existing fallback. The infra path discrepancy is in the test. The D209 sentences agree with published-version UI starts and explicit saved-draft REST starts with `versionId` and `allowDraft:true`. Resume/Replay retain the pinned version. [Workspace resolver](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/packages/engine/src/run-manager.ts#L3368) · [Start route](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/apps/api/src/routes/runs.ts#L84) |

## Independent evidence checks

**Final CI.** I checked the recorded API run, six jobs, steps, raw logs, merge parents, both archive digests and all 13 package coverage totals. Run `44950929794`, attempt 1, succeeded. Unit totals were 10,328 passes and 53 skips. Browser recorded 488 passes and one skip. Windows launcher recorded 27 passes. The lowest package line and branch values were 95.00% and 90.97%, respectively. Audit reported seven low and 13 moderate advisories. The native ZIP `14725557325` was 9,224 bytes. I verified all three embedded members, checked the 338 observations for order and type totals, and matched the retained canonical replay and helper digest. No fresh execution was performed for this review. [Raw jobs](../i4-553-headb812-targeta608-ci/jobs.json) · [Coverage archive](../i4-553-headb812-targeta608-ci/coverage.zip) · [Native receipt](../i4-553-headb812-targeta608-ci-windows/verified.json)

**Earlier independent work.** I read both original Fable 5.2/xhigh general reports. Slot 1 at source 633 identified the logging and workspace gaps later addressed by D204. Slot 2 approved the six-file correction at source 4d. Its current reconstruction result, the latent diagnostic-dropping alternatives, the synthetic canonical-plus-prior cases and the timing correction for the earlier engine lint/262 cases retain their recorded limits. The final author pass was scoped. F3/F4 remain parked under #554. Authored time-budget exhaustion can follow external stalls and prior effects. It remains non-resumable. [Slot 1](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-486-authored-failures/implementation-review/continuation-02/provider/provider-final-message.md) · [Slot 2](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-486-authored-failures/implementation-review/cycle-2/provider/provider-final-message.md)

The original Opus 5.5/xhigh QA at 633 remains **CONDITIONAL**. I recomputed 430 final new checks from its raw groups and kept the 36 inherited domain checks separate. Earlier attempts preserved 100/104, 68/71 and 89/92 checks. D205 uses named, source-matched historical controls from d117/02a run `44909411264`. The separate source-4d supplement has 29 passing records, comprising 14 required scenarios, 10 D204 fixtures, one genuine A2 privacy control and four public-surface/history checks. Three of the ten D204 fixtures are synthetic. Four invalid/empty workspace cases with prior delivery state reached naturally after disk restart. The built RunManager used scripted ports where documented. The surface checks cover authenticated API/SQLite, built MCP stdio and Chromium. Reopen used candidate-written history. CLI option placement, browser PID observation, preview A04, old-build upgrade, exhaustive native faults, live paid providers and full Windows package execution retain their limitations. I independently matched the lengths and digests of all 200 original and 158 supplemental sealed members. [Original QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-486-authored-failures/independent-qa/continuation-02/REPORT.md) · [Supplement](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-486-authored-failures/independent-qa/d205-supplement/REPORT.md)

**Previous failed CI.** Run `44934348117` remains failed. Its browser job recorded 487 passes, one skip and one failure. The other five jobs passed. The Linux target missed the second reload before a teardown `/worker/reset` error masked the earlier failure. D213 recorded four passes and one failure on Windows. Both target invocations passed. The predecessor failed its offline-banner assertion and the later target ran in a replacement worker. I checked the original raw run and browser failures, the five diagnostic results, and all 67 sealed members. The cause remains unknown. A direct web product edit is absent from the 54-path delta. That observation and the later green run do not resolve indirect effects, provide a pristine reproduction, or establish flakiness. #555/#556 remain parked outside the 26-issue batch. [Failed-run archive](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-486-doc-correction/failed-source-head-ci/run.json) · [Instrumented outcomes](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-486-doc-correction/instrumented-diagnostic/outcomes.json)

**Archive and bounded correction.** I compared every parent tree entry. `b812` added 435 archive files and appended policies in `.gitattributes` and `.prettierignore`. All 37,997 pre-existing nonpolicy entries, including 36,246 QA archive entries, retained their modes and blob IDs. Both old policy prefixes were byte-identical. I streamed the 435 new Git blobs and reconciled the manifest and all 434 payload rows. The Fable 5.2/xhigh D209/D211 invocation 03 returned `ACCEPT FIX` on the bounded correction. Preparations 01 and 02 were undispatched. The D211 historical file was 187,030 bytes with its original hash and one set of seven-character markers. Its effective attribute was 32, and ordinary RunManager source had no such attribute. The earlier full cached check is a retained receipt. [Evidence carry](../i4-b812-static-carry-root-02/final-source-evidence-proof.accepted.json) · [Bounded Fable report](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b8126de18080b76b15cbbbbc00fd791030fec3e1/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-486-doc-correction/actual-fable03/provider/provider-final-message.md)

The archive selected 417 originals and references two local-only originals, the full-tree proof and the 51 MB browser ZIP. D208 separately retains 22 historical local-only proof members and two compressed artifacts. The earlier generated test-store keys remain unrevoked for their exact stores. Keep those stores offline. Archive scans and observed public surfaces provide bounded privacy evidence. This review verified the archive identities and followed relevant raw members. It did not perform an exhaustive content audit of all historical members.

**Disposition.** P2 requires correction before technical approval. P3 records the narrower coverage gap. General slot 3 is consumed. The register reserves human postmerge observation, owner acceptance and deployment for separate decisions. The #460 hold and intent 5 ordering remain in force. This review made no product, index, provider, GitHub or owner-environment changes.
